entries.title: Zimbabwe v Australia - 2nd ODI
entries.hook: Australia's middle-order auditions meet Raza's experienced Zimbabwe side in Harare.
entries.synopsis: With the 2027 World Cup approaching, Australia are looking for a settled middle order after several senior retirements. Zimbabwe offer a useful examination in familiar conditions: Sikandar Raza leads in Richard Ngarava's injury absence, with Brendan Taylor and Graeme Cremer back in the squad. Watch the contest between Australia's developing batting combinations and Zimbabwe's varied attack.

facts.statement: Zimbabwe will co-host the 2027 ODI World Cup.
Raza captains with Ngarava injured; Taylor and Cremer return.
Australia are rebuilding their middle order after senior retirements.
The second and third ODIs are on 18 and 20 September in Harare.

entries.title: Zimbabwe v Australia - 3rd ODI
entries.hook: Harare offers one last examination before Australia move on to South Africa.
entries.synopsis: The third ODI closes this Zimbabwe leg of Australia's World Cup preparation. Selection opportunities remain part of the bigger picture, while the hosts are building towards a tournament they will co-host. Zimbabwe's experienced core and Blessing Muzarabani's pace give Australia more to solve than a routine final outing.

facts.statement: Zimbabwe will co-host the 2027 ODI World Cup.
Raza captains with Ngarava injured; Taylor and Cremer return.
Australia are rebuilding their middle order after senior retirements.
The second and third ODIs are on 18 and 20 September in Harare.
